cipher.seams: CreationStoreSeam (self-contained) — contract, fixtures, mock inputs and contract tests changed; CreationStoreSeam (legacy flat) re-exports it unchanged; ClockSeam — consulted, not modified
cipher.summary: Added an optional `modeId` to `DraftRecordSchema` so an autosaved draft records the question its evidence was typed under, re-captured the sample fixture's outputs from a real browser through `probes/browser-seams.probe.mjs`, and moved every judgement about a stored id — live, absent, or retired — into pure `src/lib/core/draft-restore.ts`, which also produces the sentence the studio now shows about what it restored. The draft's `updatedAtISO` moved from an unseamed `new Date()` to `ClockSeam`.
cipher.risks: The field is optional, so a draft can still arrive with no mode and the studio still opens on the default for it — the mitigation is that it now says so rather than substituting silently, and both non-recorded cases are covered by contract, unit and end-to-end tests. A blank `modeId` is refused by `NonEmptyStringSchema` (red proof: `rejected.draftWithBlankModeId` in `fixtures/creation-store/fault.json`), so corruption cannot masquerade as age. This pull request carries a contract change and is therefore held rather than auto-merged, per `AGENTS.md`.
